scope: V11 current mixed three-member bolt stacks; 24 axes, 144 admitted axis/case states.

decision.reason: The admitted forces are available at both actual shear planes, but the reused source-bound methods have no applicable whole-fastener interaction for these asymmetric three-member stacks. The available single-shear references are plane components and cannot be summed or treated as a joint result.

steel_wood_steel.side_action_magnitude_check: For each saved side pair, compare abs(left_lateral_force_N - right_lateral_force_N) against 1e-9 * max(left_lateral_force_N, right_lateral_force_N, 1 N); all 48 exceed the tolerance.
steel_wood_steel.method_disposition: NDS symmetric double shear does not apply to the 48 unequal side-action states. The existing kernel requires the symmetric double-shear inputs; NDS 12.3.5.4's shorter-side rule handles side bearing length, not unequal side actions.

plywood_wood_steel.method_disposition: The two outer members are an analytical paired-plywood cleat and a steel angle, so identical outer side members required by the symmetric double-shear route are absent. The current per-plane plywood/sawn and sawn/steel values remain separate component references.

full_wrench_scope.interpretation: The EYM lateral-yield equations include their modeled dowel-bearing and fastener-bending modes. The source records no separate explicit applied shaft/end-capture moment vectors. Actual signed section N/M/V is retained in the plane report; it is not discarded, double-counted as an independent couple, or combined with lateral Z absent a supported interaction rule. EYM lateral Z also does not qualify the recorded axial end-capture force or an N/V interaction.

precise_missing_method: A source-supported asymmetric three-member fastener yield interaction that maps the simultaneous two plane force vectors, each side's actual material/geometry, and shared dowel bending into one joint capacity. Separate two-member plane Z references do not supply this interaction.
A source-supported interaction for lateral EYM with the nonzero axial end-capture force. No axial capacity or N/V interaction is calculated by this disposition.
No independent applied couple is identified in the current capture/body-load records. Internal section moments remain reported; no additional free-couple capacity check is asserted.

reusable_component_result.qualification: Conditional two-member plane references only; not additive across planes and not whole-joint demand bounds or pass results.

NDS_2024_multi_member_kernel.relevant_scope: Three-member branch is the symmetric double-shear method; code requires same side properties and equal opposing side actions. Four-or-more-member branch does not apply to these three-member stacks.

AWC_TR12.relevant_scope: Existing single-shear equations and symmetric double-shear derivation do not establish the missing unequal-side three-member interaction.
